comments_highlight_note_requires_highlig.name: comments_highlight_note_requires_highlight
comments_highlight_note_requires_highlig.value: "comments"."highlight_note" is null or "comments"."highlighted_at" is not null

comments_body_matches_state.name: comments_body_matches_state
comments_body_matches_state.value: ("comments"."deleted_at" is null and char_length("comments"."body") between 1 and 2000) or ("comments"."deleted_at" is not null and "comments"."body" is null)

media_assets_attachment_matches_status.name: media_assets_attachment_matches_status
media_assets_attachment_matches_status.value: ("media_assets"."status" = 'attached') = ("media_assets"."post_id" is not null and "media_assets"."position" is not null)

reports_target_matches_type.name: reports_target_matches_type
reports_target_matches_type.value:
num_nonnulls("reports"."post_id", "reports"."comment_id", "reports"."target_user_id") = 1
        and ("reports"."target_type" <> 'post' or "reports"."post_id" is not null)
        and ("reports"."target_type" <> 'comment' or "reports"."comment_id" is not null)
        and ("reports"."target_type" <> 'user' or "reports"."target_user_id" is not null)

posts_title_length.name: posts_title_length
posts_title_length.value: "posts"."title" is null or char_length("posts"."title") between 1 and 150

posts_body_matches_state.name: posts_body_matches_state
posts_body_matches_state.value: ("posts"."deleted_at" is null and char_length("posts"."body") between 1 and 5000) or ("posts"."deleted_at" is not null and "posts"."body" is null)

users_deletion_scheduled_at_idx.name: users_deletion_scheduled_at_idx
users_deletion_scheduled_at_idx.where: "users"."deletion_scheduled_at" is not null and "users"."deleted_at" is null
